# pyyaml reads the skill/agent frontmatter surface for the hook-exec-form gate
# (#2569): YAML has no jq, and a hand-rolled walk lost three review rounds to
# spellings it had not anticipated. Unlike the pure-Python pins above this is a
# C-extension wheel, so its hashes are ABI-specific — the cp314 set covers the
# CI interpreter (3.14, pinned in the root .python-version that every ci.yml
# setup-python step resolves; a bump there and the cpXY hash sets here move
# together) on Linux x64 plus the platforms the fleet develops on;
# the cp311 set covers the cloud VM system Python (3.11) and the same fleet
# platforms (#2654). scripts/check-hook-exec-form.sh reads this pin directly
# and borrows the same version through `uv run --with` when a local python
# lacks the module, so a developer never has to match this list by hand.

# tree-sitter and one grammar wheel per language code-tidying's change-shape.py
# maps (Python, C#, TypeScript, Bash, JavaScript, YAML) are pinned so its
# grammar-dependent suite RUNS in CI instead of skipping green, the same reason
# pygments is pinned above (#1313). The core wheel is per-interpreter, so it
# carries cp314 (CI) and cp311 (cloud VM) sets on the fleet platforms; every
# grammar ships abi3 wheels, so those carry one hash per platform. The core
# publishes no cp311/cp314 wheel for musllinux aarch64 or win32, which is why
# its set is two entries shorter than pyyaml's.

# zizmor is the Actions security lint, previously reached through the
# ci-workflows zizmor reusable workflow. 1.27.0 is the version that reusable
# takes by default at the SHA this repository pinned it to, so the lint step in
# ci.yml is a like-for-like replacement and no security-lane behaviour changed
# inside a performance change. The reusable downloaded a native release archive
# and verified a SHA-256 input; this pin lands on the reviewed Dependabot pip
# surface instead. Like pyyaml above this is a platform-specific wheel, so the
# hash is the manylinux_2_28_x86_64 build the ubuntu-24.04 runner resolves
# (that image ships glibc 2.39). A host outside that platform cannot install
# from this file under --require-hashes.
zizmor==1.30.0 \
